comments.mergedPostDetails:
I have a disability which makes it very hard for me to remember names and faces -which is even harder on VRC when people can change their appearance so easily.
I make use of a mod called EMMvrc which allows me to make personal notes about people I meet to help me remember who they are and where I met them. This is so helpful for me and without it, I wouldn't be able to use the game comfortably.
If this feature could be added to the base game, I would appreciate it, even though with mods being removed by this EAC thing, I will lose all the notes I have at the moment.
Kind regards,
Kyuu
comments.mergedPostTitle: Ability to make notes about users you meet in game

comments.mergedPostDetails:
Problem:
We have many conversations with different people all the time, and sometimes we friend them and don't remember where we met them. Because of that the development of a friendship or social interaction is severed.
Solution:
Editable bio per friend a player can do in his friends list, so you remember where you met the player and any relevant information you need to keep the conversation going.

If you play VRChat, you are more likely to make many friends in the in-game. It doesn't matter if the number of friends is small, but if the number of friends is large, it is often seen that each friend can't remember who it is. So I suggest adding a simple memo function. For example, I think it's a convenient feature to add a memo function to your friend's profile to write "where you met and who you are."
comments.mergedPostTitle: Add notes from your social friends list

details: They would be shown to yourself only and can be edited. One textfield only for short, one-to two sentences long descriptions/memos for yourself. Kinda like in Discord. By default the notes box would be empty.
